title: Observable Propagation: Uncovering Feature Vectors in Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution using traditionally male and female names in prompt templates, measuring logit differences between stereotypically male and female occupations (e.g., 'programmer' vs. 'nurse'), and utilizing a novel method called Observable Propagation (OBPROP) to extract and analyze the internal feature vectors responsible for these biased outputs.
